say:1:1220608001:1.text:
Ah, it's you!
Flora told me how you saved her. I can't thank you enough!
say:1:1220608001:1.source_cn: 是你啊。\n弗洛拉说你救了他，太感谢了。
say:1:1220608001:1.male:
Ah, it's you!
Flora told me how you saved her. I can't thank you enough!
say:1:1220608001:1.female:
Ah, it's you!
Flora told me how you saved her. I can't thank you enough!

say:2:1220608002:1.text:
I fear I'm not the best mother...
Sigh... if only there was some foolproof guidebook for these things.
say:2:1220608002:1.source_cn: 我大概不是个合格的母亲……\n唉，如果能有个人教教我该...
say:2:1220608002:1.male:
I fear I'm not the best mother...
Sigh... if only there was some foolproof guidebook for these things.
say:2:1220608002:1.female:
I fear I'm not the best mother...
Sigh... if only there was some foolproof guidebook for these things.

say:3:1220608003:1.text: She obsesses over going out to sea, just like my husband who never returned!
say:3:1220608003:1.source_cn: 她每天都心心念念着要出海，跟我那个再也不回来的丈夫一样！
say:3:1220608003:1.male: She obsesses over going out to sea, just like my husband who never returned!
say:3:1220608003:1.female: She obsesses over going out to sea, just like my husband who never returned!

say:4:1220608004:1.text: I cannot permit her to set sail, no matter what. I know it will cause her pain, but this is a line I must draw.
say:4:1220608004:1.source_cn: 无论如何，我都不能让她到海上去。我知道这样会让她难过，...
say:4:1220608004:1.male: I cannot permit her to set sail, no matter what. I know it will cause her pain, but this is a line I must draw.
say:4:1220608004:1.female: I cannot permit her to set sail, no matter what. I know it will cause her pain, but this is a line I must draw.

say:5:1220608005:1.text: I've lost so much already... I can't lose Flora, too.
say:5:1220608005:1.source_cn: 我已经失去很多了，唯独弗洛拉，我不能失去她……
say:5:1220608005:1.male: I've lost so much already... I can't lose Flora, too.
say:5:1220608005:1.female: I've lost so much already... I can't lose Flora, too.
